name: Hotellia
summary: Square-cornered, grey-and-white Mediterranean boutique hotel site with an all-caps Baskerville voice, a giant wordmark bleeding off the hero and sticky stacked experience cards.

fonts.pairing: all-caps transitional serif for every heading and label, plain Inter for body copy

signature: hotel name set as a giant all-caps serif wordmark cropped by the bottom of the hero and repeated in the footer
experience rows as full-width white cards that stick and stack while scrolling
a signed letter from the manager as a homepage section
zero radius everywhere: photos, cards and buttons are hard rectangles on light grey
imagery: sunlit terracotta and whitewash Mediterranean architecture, pools, arched rooms with beamed ceilings, warm daylight
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 20px side padding, 64px section padding and 64px header gap, 2-column rooms, 3-column experience rows
